svg.title: Why half-fixed, as a scan report
svg.desc: learns from your own fixes: every fix in your history is a test case for the code next to it (proof: Prism's 9447c71 fixed 2 of 10 tool maps; half-fixed found the 4 that kept the bug). finds real bugs: its findings became pull requests in two well-known projects (proof: prism-php/prism#1038, BerriAI/litellm#44925, BerriAI/litellm#44936). fast and offline: runs git and nothing else: no model, no network, no telemetry (proof: 5,000 LiteLLM commits in 69 s). evidence, not autofix: your agent checks each finding against the original fix before it touches code (proof: 66 LiteLLM findings checked: 13 real gaps, 52 deliberate or handled, 1 unsure). works with your agent: Claude Code and Codex plugins, Agent Skills for any agent, and a standalone CLI (try: npx skills add heyzainali/half-fixed). catches it in review: --base flags a branch that fixes two siblings and forgets the third (proof: flagged DeepSeek and OpenAI on the branch behind prism-php/prism#1038).
svg.text: why every fix in your history is a test case for the code next to it
